title: Tamed Mysterious Mushroom
body:
The Tamed Mysterious Mushroom is a flower that can be found in the Mushroom Cave, near the Oobmab Lake. It is located in the same place where the Fusion Coil is crafted. It is used as a dye and as an ingredient for crafting the Petalfall Katana.

It can be sold to Jer Junkman for $150, or in its dye form for $600.

When put into a Composter, its fill level increases by ~28.57%
